description: Image Description: The image showcases a close-up view of a freshly baked pizza served on a white ceramic plate. The pizza features a golden-brown crust with slightly charred spots, indicating it was cooked at high heat, likely in a wood-fired oven. The surface is generously topped with melted mozzarella cheese, which has browned in places, creating a rich, bubbly texture. A vibrant red tomato sauce is visible beneath the cheese, adding color and depth to the dish. Fresh green basil leaves
